entries.نکتهٔ امنیتی: محافظ صفحه یک قفل نمایشی ا: Security note: the screen saver is a display lock — after waking, the same user session continues and the password only re-verifies that user's identity; for a full lock, sign the user out of the system.
entries.پس از بی‌حرکتیِ تعیین‌شده، افکت باران ما: After the configured idle time, a full-screen matrix rain effect turns on showing the current time. The saver wakes with the first mouse move or key press — in "password mode", waking is only possible with that logged-in user's password.
entries.صفحه قفل است — برای ادامه، رمز کاربر جار: The page is locked — to continue, enter the current user's password
entries.تنظیمات فعلی محافظ صفحه با محتوای فایل ج: Replace the current screen saver settings with the file contents?
entries.برون‌بری: تنظیمات جاری محافظ صفحه (وضعیت: Export: the current screen saver settings (state, minutes, seconds, wake with password) download as a JSON file. Import: upload an exported file to apply the same settings on this installation — e.g. to keep several installations identical.
entries.فایل تنظیمات محافظ صفحه را انتخاب کنید: Select the screen saver settings file

entries.تنظیمات محافظ صفحه درون‌ریزی شد — وضعیت:: Screen saver settings imported — state: {0}, time: {1}, wake: {2}
entries.بسته‌های محافظ صفحه — انتقال خودِ اسکرین: Screen saver packages — transfer the screen saver itself
entries.کد هر بسته در یک لایهٔ سندباکس ایزوله اج: Each package's code runs inside an isolated sandbox layer — with no access to the system's cookies, session, page or network; still, only import packages you trust. After import, the package is activated automatically.
entries.بستهٔ پیش‌فرض سامانه: نویسه‌های باران از: The system's default package: rain characters follow the current language, Vazirmatn font
entries.اعمال تنظیمات همراه بسته: Apply the settings bundled with the package
entries.بستهٔ محافظ صفحه از فایل درون‌ریزی و فعا: Import and activate the screen saver package from the file? The package code runs inside the isolated sandbox layer.
entries.قالب بسته: فایل JSON با format=hr-screen: Package format: a JSON file with format=hr-screensaver-package containing meta (name/author/version/description), code (js/css) and optional settings — for a ready sample, click "Export package" on the built-in saver row.
entries.حجم فایل بسته باید کمتر از ۱ مگابایت باش: The package file must be smaller than 1 megabyte

entries.محافظ صفحهٔ داخلی سامانه: باران ماتریکس: The system's built-in screen saver: matrix rain with the current language's characters, Vazirmatn font, a small date/time corner and the company brand — as a standalone package for other installations.
